qualifications: A sworn declaration of at least US$350,000 in financial resources is an eligibility requirement, separate from the US$240,000 NEF contribution and government fees. Apply the amended dependant and prior-visa-refusal rules. Built-property legislation does not by itself establish available projects. The investment page and older FAQ retain incompatible NEF and diligence figures; no unqualified subtotal is selected.
Interview/identity verification is payable by the principal; its amount, passport, document and agent costs are excluded.
No independently verified end-to-end passport delivery time
Newly covered ongoing duties are route-specific; prescribed day counts, renewal charges or project availability remain gaps unless explicitly stated.
